node.statement: The smooth scalar action on calU_e is free and proper. Freeness follows because cU=U and a right inverse U bold-dot R=J imply cJ=(cU) bold-dot R=U bold-dot R=J, hence c=1 since ||J||=1. Properness follows from the standard compact-group argument: U(1) is compact, and for compact K in calU_e x calU_e the inverse image under (c,U) mapsto (cU,U) is a closed subset of U(1) x pr_2(K), hence compact.
